data.title: Repo hygiene: untrack node_modules, resolve dependabot queue, stale-branch inventory

data.body: Plan complete. HYG-1: root node_modules is vercel CLI (4943 files) committed pre-ignore; clean git rm --cached. HYG-2: all 7 dependabot PRs MERGEABLE/CLEAN, green CI — merge all 7 (5 CI-action bumps then 2 web). HYG-3: git-driven branch inventory, no deletions.

Implement done. HYG-1: node_modules untracked (git ls-files|grep -c node_modules=0), c11-logic suite green (1183 tests, 0 failures) proving build unaffected; restore path documented in CONTRIBUTING.md. HYG-2: 6 dependabot PRs merged (#279/#278/#277/#260/#259 CI-action bumps + #308 web group); #250 (eslint 9->10) auto-merged on green CI then REVERTED via #314 — CI doesn't run eslint and eslint 10 fatally crashes bun lint (eslint-config-next's eslint-plugin-react uses removed context.getFilename()); main back on eslint ^9. Zero open dependabot PRs. HYG-3: branch-inventory.md artifact committed (87 local + 164 remote, merged-status, no deletions).

COMPLETE (fast-track, stopped at pr_open). PR #315 open against main (head 5d0932bd1 != base). All 3 HYG rows PASS: HYG-1 node_modules untracked (grep=0, c11-logic 1183/0 green, restore doc in CONTRIBUTING); HYG-2 zero open dependabot PRs (6 merged, #250 eslint-10 reverted via #314 with documented reason, main on eslint ^9); HYG-3 branch-inventory.md committed + attached (87 local + 164 remote, no deletions). Tagged-build screenshot N/A (no UI surface; build integrity proven by c11-logic). Orchestrator to merge #315. STOP — not self-merging.

Merged by orchestrator (PR #315, squash, 2026-07-07T07:25:16Z). Gates verified: validation artifacts (inline validation note, stale-branch inventory file, PR reference) + review artifact + full CI green (build, compat-tests, web-typecheck, guards). HYG-1: node_modules untracked, grep=0, c11-logic 1183/0. HYG-2: 6 dependabot PRs merged, #250 eslint-10 reverted via #314 (CI runs no eslint — footgun logged). HYG-3: branch inventory (87 local + 164 remote) attached for operator review; zero deletions.
